text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With an all-out run, Mihono Bourbon defied 
all expectations beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the upcoming Spring Stakes, the 
distance increases to 1,800m. Thus, she 
deduced that further stamina reinforcement 
would be required.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, she bumped right into 
Rice Shower at the entrance of the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deeply impressed by the running of Mihono 
Bourbon, whom she admired, she stammered 
out words of praise before shyly walking 
away.
